# PDFium Chromium 7988 Linux x64

The retained `pdfium-linux-x64-7988.tgz` is the unmodified PDFium binaries
release artifact used only by the repository's test tooling. It was downloaded
from:

https://github.com/bblanchon/pdfium-binaries/releases/download/chromium/7988/pdfium-linux-x64.tgz

Its SHA-256 digest is:

`7358c15e26a746cd67854887ea11b3b807c436056788eee9294fb972b8f8e0be`

Its SHA-512 digest is:

`91f57e2e77d098ecfd9f247fe67831da89d8f33a68b358973a4c2e0f08e19b73551e80224991d459a68acff5fe2f525dd4c6c5c7834c6099df64b62b0f07e723`

The archive retains its top-level `LICENSE` and complete `licenses/`
directory. Those embedded files are the authoritative license and attribution
material for PDFium and every bundled third-party component. The archive is
not linked into or invoked by the production Roc package.
